judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote a `.lore/dod.md` file, a single failing acceptance test (`src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), and a four-line stub in `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, without implementing any production code. None of the required changes to `src/types/messages.ts`, `validation.ts`, `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, or `ErrorCodes` were made. The test calls `createMessageHandler` with signature and message types (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`) that do not exist yet, so it will fail to compile and fail at runtime. Almost every acceptance criterion in the issue was left completely unaddressed.
